# `hash`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
hash(expr1, expr2, ...)
```

Returns a hash value of the arguments.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `hash_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 2.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | > 0 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- hash, example 1
> SELECT hash('Spark', array(123), 2);

```
